result.rationale: Verified in the diff: the migration create_embeddable_hosts only creates host and category_id columns with no unique index, the EmbeddableHost model has only a format validation (no uniqueness), and record_for_host uses where(...).first with no ORDER BY, so duplicate hosts can coexist and which row wins is DB-order dependent. This is a real correctness/data-integrity gap introduced by the diff, though consequences are silent mis-categorization rather than a crash.
